items.source: Returns if the Persistable is new or was persisted already.
items.translation: 返回该 Persistable 是新的还是已经持久化。

items.source: Returns the id of the entity.

Note that methods declared in this interface (getId() and isNew()) become property accessors when implementing this interface in combination with @AccessType(PROPERTY). Either of these can be marked as transient when annotated with @Transient.
items.translation: 请注意，在此接口中声明的方法（getId() 和 isNew()）在结合使用 @AccessType(PROPERTY) 实现该接口时，会变为属性访问器。这些方法若被 @Transient 注解标记，则可以声明为 transient。
